name: Chess Cartoons
description:
Play a hilarious game of chess with your friend in Chess Cartoons ! If no friend is around climb up the difficulty ladders and play against an increasing diffuclty computer controller opponent starting at difficulty of 50 or just play a simple game against a computer controlled opponent and chose one of three difficulties. Choose your color and start as white or play as balck. 
A hilarious chess game for you and your friend!

Features :
- Three difficulties against computer controller oppponent
- Two player mode with controller and touch screen support
- Difficulty Ladders mode up to 1000
